source.title: Extensive monitoring of the natural menstrual cycle using the serum biomarkers estradiol, luteinizing hormone and progesterone
source.inspected: Final primary full text and complete original DOCX supplementary materials; Table 1, supplementary Methods and Tables S1–S3.

transcription.location: Table 1: Analysis of main menstrual cycle phases: E2 concentration (pmol/L), columns N and Median.
transcription.countMeaning: N is the number of patients contributing to the phase, not the number of samples; Table 1 footnote a.
transcription.statistic: Across-participant summary of within-participant phase median values, reported as typical phase values to account for visit-participant correlation. It is not a validated percentile of a single randomly timed sample.
transcription.notImported: No Table 1 p5/p95, their confidence intervals, LH/progesterone rows, seven sub-phase values, exact-day medians or fitted age model are imported into this information block.

exclusions: Hormonal contraception during the preceding 90 days and study period; pregnancy or lactation.
Fertility, gonadal, endocrine and other specified disorders, according to supplementary Methods.
Nonovulatory and atypical hormone profiles, including low follicular E2, excluded from analysis.
population.limitation: The app does not establish all study eligibility criteria and does not infer that unknown treatment, pregnancy, lactation or disease history is negative.

method.lod: Not separately specified in the source study.
method.loq: Not separately specified in the source study.
method.censoring: No generic low-value imputation rule was identified. The lower measuring-range boundary is not relabeled as LOD/LOQ. Patient inequalities remain inequalities.

phaseDefinitions.follicular: First menstrual day through OV−2 days.
phaseDefinitions.luteal: OV+2 days through last cycle day.
phaseDefinitions.standardization: The study standardized cycles to 29 days with ovulation on day 15. Ovulation was inferred from hormone profiles and expert review, without independent ultrasound confirmation.
phaseDefinitions.application: Reuse only the current E2 phase already selected in the existing optional editor. Do not infer phase from hormone value, require an exact cycle day, or silently copy LH/FSH context.

applicationPolicy.wholePossibleAgeInterval: [18,37], conservative application envelope, not recovered precision of authors' age endpoints.
applicationPolicy.preserveExact18: The separate source-information evaluator does not modify ordinary patientPointData or Madsen's exact-18 age reference.
applicationPolicy.knownExclusions: Current known pregnancy, menopause, lactation, hormonal treatment/stimulation and incompatible assay/specimen withhold this information block. Unknown history does not confirm absence.
applicationPolicy.unitEquivalents: Rounded display equivalents 53.9/206/112 pg/mL use the application's existing E2 conversion 3.671 pmol/L per pg/mL; the patient conversion implementation is unchanged.
applicationPolicy.measurementInequality: A valid inequality may leave the published group statistic visible. It does not create an exact patient concentration, graphical point or comparison.
applicationPolicy.presentation: Compact information block below the unchanged chart, outside SVG, for all three phases. Values 412/757 are never clamped to the unchanged scale of 264 pmol/L.
unchanged: Ordinary source profiles and their age/stage routing
Illustrative curve, fixed scale and sex comparisons
Laboratory reference intervals, result status, range bar and conversion panel
AMH-only educational-reference snapshots and saved historical assessments

ownerApproval.scope: Accepted interactive desktop/mobile E2 mockup and instructed implementation, with explicit preservation of the current numerical-result panel and laboratory range display.
